title: Waterfront places to walk in and around Kochi
description: Compare a city promenade, two beachside walks and a waterfront park.
intro: Four waterside places offer different walks: a city promenade, a historic waterfront, a beach on Vypin island and a central park. Distances are approximate where supplied; these are not verified running routes. Access and conditions can change.

entries.name: Marine Drive
entries.description: Kerala Tourism describes a roughly 3 km promenade from High Court Junction to Rajendra Maidan. The waterside path is the clearest choice here if you want a longer walk with a stated approximate length; the tourism page says vehicles are not allowed on the walkway.
entries.details: Ernakulam · approx. 3 km · promenade without vehicles

entries.name: Fort Kochi Beach
entries.description: Kerala Tourism describes a granite walkway by Fort Kochi beach and the adjacent Vasco da Gama Square. The official page says a portion of the beach is under naval control and not open to visitors; it does not state a length for the walk.
entries.details: Fort Kochi · beachside walkway · length not confirmed

entries.name: Subhash Chandra Bose Park
entries.description: This central park overlooks the lake and harbour. Kerala Tourism places it next to Ernakulam boat jetty and opposite Maharaja’s College, which makes it easy to identify on a city map; check opening times before travelling.
entries.details: Ernakulam · waterfront park · beside the boat jetty

entries.name: Cherai Beach
entries.description: Kerala Tourism notes a beach walkway and children’s park on Vypin island. The source does not provide a route length; this is a separate outing from central Ernakulam rather than an extension of Marine Drive.
entries.details: Vypin island · beach walkway · length not confirmed
